'''Ann Margaret Lewis''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Author/Legends|author]] of ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''. She received her information from the [[Shi'ido]] [[sentientologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ann Margaret Lewis was [[Tuckerization|named after]] the [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|real-life Ann Margaret Lewis]] who wrote [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']].
